method: Native PPO 400 controls (Channel 2000), full zero/trained/fresh frozen episodes. Same 256x256 task-conditioned padded MLP. Specialist timing pilots are not a trained joint model.
limitations: One timing seed; longer budgets are extrapolations. No paper convergence, universal learning improvement, or eight-way linear scaling claim.

profile.scope: Official class defaults; YAML mismatch is unresolved, not silently applied

runtime_profile.scope: Frozen organizer native runtime profile. Not a recovered paper protocol.

cases.training_note: The unmodified class failed three PPO pilots at different exploration scales. This release explicitly repairs actuator ramp time to the local 50-CFD-step control window, leaving outer episode clock/grid/dt/reward/action bounds unchanged. Zero-flow-control invariance and first-window invariance checked; not an unmodified-paper result.
